proc initQueue[T](q: var SyncQueue[T]) =

proc pop[T](q: var SyncQueue[T]): T =

    if q.data.len > 0:

      q.data.delete(0)

import std/locks

var
  rwLock: Lock
  readerCount = 0
  resourceLock: Lock

proc acquireRead() =
  acquire(rwLock)
  inc(readerCount)
  if readerCount == 1:
    acquire(resourceLock)
  release(rwLock)

proc releaseRead() =
  acquire(rwLock)
  dec(readerCount)
  if readerCount == 0:
    release(resourceLock)
  release(rwLock)

proc acquireWrite() =
  acquire(resourceLock)

proc releaseWrite() =
  release(resourceLock)

proc readerWorker() {.thread.} =
  acquireRead()
  echo "Reading..."
  releaseRead()

when isMainModule:
  initLock(rwLock)
  initLock(resourceLock)
  
  var t: Thread[void]
  createThread(t, readerWorker)
  
  acquireWrite()
  echo "Writing..."
  releaseWrite()
  
  joinThread(t)
  deinitLock(resourceLock)
  deinitLock(rwLock)

  else:

  release(barLock)
